lint.message: OCA\SocialLogin\Provider\CustomOAuth2::__construct(): Implicitly marking parameter $httpClient as nullable is deprecated, the explicit nullable type must be used instead
OCA\SocialLogin\Provider\CustomOAuth2::__construct(): Implicitly marking parameter $storage as nullable is deprecated, the explicit nullable type must be used instead
OCA\SocialLogin\Provider\CustomOAuth2::__construct(): Implicitly marking parameter $logger as nullable is deprecated, the explicit nullable type must be used instead

lines: 1 require or include names a file the release does not ship: a server stops on such a require, and such an include leaves out what the file defines.
Ship the file (keep_extra in ncmake.mk for a directory outside the shipped set, or a line less in .nextcloudignore), or guard the include with is_file().
3 deprecations or warnings while parsing the shipped PHP files.
Each still works on that PHP, and is what a later PHP removes.
